title: Engineering Work Order
description: DC-003-I029 — one approved engineering task, authored by the Strategy Office. Replaces an informal markdown milestone brief with a structured, permanent repository object. This schema intentionally supports every status a future milestone (the Bridge Layer) may need to set directly — DC-003-I029's own CLI (`npm run engineering -- work create`) only ever creates a Work Order with status 'draft' or 'ready', per its own brief's explicit 'do not invent workflow transitions' instruction; 'in_progress'/'completed'/'approved'/'archived' exist in this enum for forward compatibility, not because this milestone's own CLI produces them.

repository_commit.description: The repository commit this Work Order was authored against (its own 'starting point'), or null if genuinely unknown at authoring time. Never the commit the resulting delivery produces — that belongs on the Engineering Delivery Report.

review_criteria.description: The Strategy Office's own numbered review checklist for this task — every milestone brief in this project's history has included one; this field makes it a structured, queryable list instead of markdown prose.

approved_at.description: Set only once the Strategy Office has approved this task to begin — null for 'draft', required for every other status. Approval is never automated by this repository (see README 'Status Model').

dependencies.description: Other Work Order IDs this one depends on. Referential integrity (that a referenced ID actually exists) is a store/service-layer concern, not enforced by this schema.
